text:
Maya: Quick sync 0— need to lock GA acceptance criteria for the Dedicated pilot: SLA tiers, minimal public docs, support/oncall handoff, monitoring deliverables, and pricing (burst vs committed). Can we assign owners + deadlines today?
Alex: Start with simple tiers: bronze/silver/gold. We can evolve to per-customer SLOs later.
Jordan: Proposed SLOs (inference p95/p99):
bronze p95 <=350ms p99 <=900ms uptime 99.5%
silver p95 <=250ms p99 <=700ms uptime 99.9%
gold   p95 <=120ms p99 <=350ms uptime 99.95%
Also error-rate targets: bronze <1% silver <0.5% gold <0.2% and synthetic cold/warm checks.
Priya: Need clear triage rules: what is incident vs ticket, who does first-touch. Suggest Platform handles auto-detect + remediation; human escalation differs by tier. I'll propose rotation names by EOD.
Sam: Sales note: gold expects white-glove onboarding and a direct Slack channel; discounts for 12/24mo. Don't promise until docs + price confirmed.
Ravi (Finance): Gold SLAs raise operating cost (reserve warming + 24/7 support) ~18-25%. Suggest capped credits: silver <=10% monthly, gold <=25% for severe breaches. Legal review required.
Elena: Docs split: public SLA summary + pricing matrix + onboarding FAQ; internal runbooks: escalation, throttling/fallbacks, dashboards. I can draft public pages once SLOs + fallback behavior are final.
DeployBot: [deploy] Created dashboard template "sla-band-template-v1" by Jordan (https://dashboards/redwood/sla-band-template-v1)
Maya: Owners & due dates:
- Jordan: finalize SLO table, fallback behavior doc (48h)
- Elena: public SLA page + pricing matrix draft (72h)
- Priya: oncall rota + triage matrix (EOD)
- Alex: rollout policy + opt-in flow for gold (72h)
- Ravi: pricing delta + credits model (72h)
- Sam: sales play one-pager + FAQ (72h)
- Maya: compile acceptance checklist (96h)
Priya: Blocker: need Legal language for credits/SLA exceptions. Can Legal review be slotted?
Maya: I'll ping Legal. Add yourself to the review loop if you want in.
Alex: I'll add a feature flag to gate enforcement for 2 weeks post-rollout to observe.
Sam: Heads-up: two pilots already asked for gold. Please don't promise until docs & pricing are live.
Maya: Thanks everyone — I'll publish the draft checklist once Priya posts the rota. :thumbsup:
